search_contract.assignment_role_note: product_type_bridge is a KnowledgeClassificationAssignment.assignment_role, not a taxonomy node_type

match_strategy.postgresql: jsonb_array_elements(safe-array) WHERE jsonb_typeof(elem)='string' AND (elem #>> '{}') ILIKE escaped pattern
match_strategy.sqlite_tests: json_each(safe-array) WHERE type='text' AND value LIKE escaped pattern
match_strategy.non_array_legacy: coerced to empty array → no match, no error

runtime_observation.method: code + fixture + dialect SQL compile + SQLite/CI PostgreSQL execution (no production DB mutation)
runtime_observation.note: Phase 2B does not invent a synonyms table and does not mutate synonym rows. Only top-level string array elements on active product_type nodes with matching product_type_id contribute to search.

negative_rule: Synonyms linked to a different Product Type, wrong node_type, or non-string JSON elements must not match.
